test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which year was the National Human Rights Commission launched in India?
solution:
Correct answer is __**1993.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** National Human Rights** Commission (NHRC) was launched on **October 12, 1993**.
 
• Human rights are **rights inherent to all human beings, regardless of race, sex, nationality, ethnicity, language, religion, or any other status**. 
 
• Human rights cover the** right to life and liberty, freedom from slavery and torture, freedom of opinion and expression, the right to work and education e.t.c**
 
• Human rights guarded by the International Covenant on Civil and **Political Rights.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Article **12 to 35 contained in Part III** of the Constitution deal with **Fundamental Rights**.**​ **
 
• **Right to equality, including equality before law, prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth, and equality of opportunity in matters of employment** are fundamental rights.
